Parliamentary Panel Formed to Review FCRA Amendment Bill

A 31-member joint parliamentary committee has been formed to examine the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) Amendment Bill. The committee, which includes members from various political parties, will be chaired by BJP MP Sanjay Jaiswal. The bill itself is described as contentious. The panel's formation was reported by multiple outlets, with some specifying the number of members and the chairperson.
